|checkboxSBS=Yes |checkboxTOCR=No |checkbox-res=No |checkboxIsSub=No }} ==Biography== == Trivia == * His ID '''Kiin''' is based on his given name, which can either be romanized as Gi-in or Ki-in. * Has flash on his F key. * His blood type is A. * His hobby is watching YouTube videos. * Has the nickname '''Kiinsante''' for his high winrate on {{ci|K'Sante}}. === Statistics === * Reached 1000 kills in the LCK on March 5, 2022. ** Is the 18th player to reach 1000 kills in the LCK, after [[Faker]], [[PraY]], [[Bang]], [[Score]], [[Kuro]], [[Smeb]], [[Ambition]], [[Sangyoon]], [[Deft]], [[Teddy]], [[Ruler]], [[Bdd]], [[Ghost (Jang Yong-jun)|Ghost]], [[Peanut]], [[Chovy]], [[Fly (Song Yong-jun)|Fly]] and [[ShowMaker]] ** Is the second top laner to reach 1000 kills in the LCK, after [[Smeb]] ** His 1000th kill was on [[Gen.G]]'s ADC [[Ophelia]] in [[LCK/2022 Season/Spring Season|LCK 2022 Spring]] with {{ci|Gwen}} * Reached 1500 kills in the LCK on March 20, 2024. ** The 14th player and 1st top laner to reach 1500 kills in the LCK. * Reached 2000 kills in the LCK on April 18, 2026. ** Was the 11th player to reach 2000 kills in the LCK after [[Faker]], [[Deft]], [[Ruler]], [[Teddy]], [[Bdd]], [[Chovy]], [[Aiming]], [[ShowMaker]], [[Peanut]], and [[Viper (Park Do-hyeon)|Viper]] ** Is the first top laner to reach 2000 kills in the LCK ** His 2000th kill was on [[Hanwha Life Esports|HLE]]'s Jungler [[Kanavi]] in [[LCK/2026 Season/Rounds 1-2|LCK Rounds 1-2]] with {{ci|Ambessa}} * Reached 500 games in the LCK on January 22, 2023, becoming the 9th player to do so, after [[Score]], [[Faker]], [[Ruler]], [[Deft]], [[Bdd]], [[Teddy]], [[Peanut]] and [[Ghost (Jang Yong-jun)|Ghost]]. * Reached 600 games in the LCK on August 10, 2023, becoming the 5th player to do so, after [[Faker]], [[Deft]], [[Bdd]], and [[Peanut]]. * Reached 700 games in the LCK on August 28, 2024, becoming the 5th player to do so, after Faker, Deft, Bdd, and Peanut. * Reached 300 wins in [[LCK]] on July 29, 2023, becoming the 11th player to do so after [[Score]], [[Faker]], [[PraY]], [[GorillA]], [[Deft]], [[Ruler]], [[Peanut]], [[Bdd]], [[Chovy]], and [[ShowMaker]]. ** Hit this milestone in the same game as his KT teammate [[Lehends]] * Reached 400 wins in [[LCK]] on April 06, 2025, becoming the 7th player to do so after [[Faker]], [[Deft]], [[Peanut]], Bdd, Chovy, and Lehends. * Reached 3000 assists in the LCK on June 23, 2024. ** Was the 18th player to reach 3000 assists in the LCK. * The first player in the LCK to finish a split with all ten results. === Individual Awards === * Esports World Cup MVP (2025) * LCK Top-Laner of the Year (2025) * LCK 1st All-Pro Team x5 (Summer 2021, Summer 2023, Spring 2024, Summer 2024, LCK 2025) * LCK 2nd All-Pro Team x1 (Spring 2023) * LCK 3rd All-Pro Team x1 (Spring 2022) * LCK Finals MVP (Spring 2024) {{PlayerStatsTrivia}} == Tournament Results == {{PlayerResults|show=overviewpage}}
